description: Default continuity rules for Unreal Engine Level Sequence QA

rules.detection_signal: Asset Registry or validator returns missing reference.
rules.confidence_policy: High when engine API confirms; deterministic.

rules.detection_signal: Expected rule references an actor not bound in Level Sequence.
rules.confidence_policy: High only if the rule is explicit.

rules.detection_signal: Mesh/material/visibility/transform differs at sampled boundaries outside allowed transition.
rules.confidence_policy: Medium until user defines permitted changes.

rules.detection_signal: Position/rotation jump exceeds configurable threshold at a cut or continuity anchor.
rules.confidence_policy: Candidate only; camera/animation intent may explain it.

rules.detection_signal: Actor exists but rendered mask/visibility evidence shows it is absent or fully occluded.
rules.confidence_policy: Needs camera visibility + occlusion reasoning; usually reviewer-confirmed.

rules.detection_signal: Aligned reference/current renders differ under controlled profile.
rules.confidence_policy: Only compare like-for-like builds/settings; difference is not automatically defect.

rules.detection_signal: Asset/mesh/material ID differs from declared expected asset.
rules.confidence_policy: High if asset identity is explicit; lower if inferred visually.

rules.detection_signal: Missing expected-state rule or contradictory rule definitions.
rules.confidence_policy: Report configuration issue instead of hallucinating a scene defect.
